title: Audit L4/L5/SessionManager state machines and document failure modes
description: Read level4-brainstorm.js, level5-coordinator.js, session-manager.js, resume-strategy.js end-to-end. Document state machine transitions, session isolation guarantees, error recovery paths, and SessionManager usage patterns. Identify suspected failure modes (race conditions, unhandled rejections, missing timeouts) that the stress harness must exercise.
action: Produce `audit-l4-l5.md` documenting: (1) Level4Brainstorm.execute() 4-phase flow (brainstorm/synthesize/specification/verify) and where 5-round re-invocation accumulates state; (2) Level5Coordinator phase machine (init→analyzing→planning→executing→completed|failed) and which phase boundaries persistState() runs on; (3) SessionManager isolation guarantees (per-session dirs, snapshot-index.json append-write race window) and gaps; (4) ResumeStrategy modes (NATIVE/PROMPT_CONCAT/HYBRID/DISABLED) and which modes apply to L5 mid-chain interrupt; (5) Suspected failure modes table with file:line references.

criteria: audit-l4-l5.md contains '## L4 Brainstorm State Machine'
audit-l4-l5.md contains '## L5 Coordinator Phase Machine'
audit-l4-l5.md references file:line for each suspected failure mode (grep -c 'level4-brainstorm.js:' audit-l4-l5.md returns >= 3)
convergence.definition_of_done: Audit doc exists with all 4 required sections plus a failure-modes table; TASK-002 harness author can use it to pick fixtures.

files.change: New audit doc with sections: L4 State Machine, L5 Phase Machine, SessionManager Isolation, ResumeStrategy modes, Suspected Failure Modes table

implementation: Read level4-brainstorm.js fully (671 lines). Map execute() phases: brainstorm (line 220), synthesize (line 224), specification (line 228), verify (line 232). Note generateArtifacts() is sequential not parallel despite max_parallel config (line 274).

Read level5-coordinator.js fully (932 lines). Map phase machine: init→analyzing (line 399)→planning (line 405)→executing (line 411)→completed|failed (line 417, 432). Record persistState calls at each boundary (lines 402, 408, 414, 429, 440).
Read session-manager.js (376 lines). Document _appendSnapshotIndex() read-modify-write pattern at line 348 — flag as race candidate when concurrent writes hit same session.
Read resume-strategy.js (537 lines). Document HybridStrategy.resume() fallback flow at line 366. Note checkpoints capped at 10 (slice(-10) at line 218, 287).

Write audit-l4-l5.md with the 5 mandated sections. Failure-modes table: each row = {symptom, suspect_file_line, repro_hint, severity_guess}. Minimum 6 rows covering: L4 sequential bottleneck, L4 timeout_per_role unenforced, L5 mid-phase interrupt window, SessionManager snapshot-index race, concurrent L4 graph state collision, ResumeStrategy native session id loss across crashes.
